records.name: Plotdreherin Andersrum
records.biography_en: Can open a settled story from an entirely inconvenient end. Her corkscrew opens HyperNorm endings from the part nobody inspected. A dissonant card asks whether surprise can arrive without becoming another rule. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Wendung wurde von einem bislang unzuständigen Ende geöffnet.

variant_notes.note_en: Can open a settled story from an entirely inconvenient end.

records.name: Hänger Nochkurz
records.biography_en: Would like the next development to include a reliable handhold. His HyperNorm rope offers a handhold while the next sentence remains pending. A dissonant card stays beside him instead of demanding suspense. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Fortsetzung möge zunächst etwas Haltbares enthalten.

variant_notes.note_en: Would like the next development to include a reliable handhold.

records.name: Schurke Schnurrschluss
records.biography_en: Explains his motives most clearly after ensuring nobody can interrupt. His HyperNorm moustache announces a motive more neatly than his plan can support. A dissonant card interrupts before he reaches the inevitable explanation. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Motiv wird nach Ausschluss weiterer Rückfragen erläutert.

variant_notes.note_en: Explains his motives most clearly after ensuring nobody can interrupt.

records.name: Kranführer Unvermittelt
records.biography_en: Has a solution ready for a problem the story forgot to prepare. His little HyperNorm crane lowers an answer nobody prepared a question for. A dissonant card asks where the solution was waiting during the trouble. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Hilfe trifft ohne vorherige erzählerische Zuständigkeit ein.

variant_notes.note_en: Has a solution ready for a problem the story forgot to prepare.

records.name: Kellnerin Nebenspur
records.biography_en: Serves the interesting detail that keeps the relevant question waiting. Her HyperNorm tray carries the detail everybody suddenly wants to discuss. A dissonant card asks what was ordered before the distraction arrived. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Nebensache wurde ansprechend und fristgerecht serviert.

variant_notes.note_en: Serves the interesting detail that keeps the relevant question waiting.

records.name: Mime Nochpause
records.biography_en: Knows the silence means something and hopes it remembers what. His HyperNorm watch measures a silence that management calls meaningful. A dissonant card asks whether anybody is simply afraid to speak first. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bedeutung der Pause wird nach ihrer Beendigung festgestellt.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows the silence means something and hopes it remembers what.
